radiusSource: Radius 1.528 Jupiter radii from Gillon et al. 2014 (2014A&A...562L...3G), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2014A%26A...562L...3G/abstract): 109,239.8 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. GM from the mass 1.49 Jupiter masses (Gillon et al. 2014, the mass the NASA Exoplanet Archive's composite table adopts (2014A&A...562L...3G), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive, https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2014A%26A...562L...3G/abstract) times JPL's Jupiter GM. The selected GCM assumes spherical geometry; the later CHEOPS tidal-deformation inference is not applied to this model grid.
orbitalPeriodSource: Gillon et al. 2014 (2014A&A...562L...3G), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname GILLON_ET_AL__2014): P 0.925542 d

shape.qualification: The reference sphere of the SPARC/MITgcm atmospheric simulation, scaled to the published transit radius. CHEOPS inferred tidal deformation (Barros et al. 2022), but that separate shape model is not the geometry of this dataset.

massSource: 1.49 Jupiter masses: Gillon et al. 2014, the mass the NASA Exoplanet Archive's composite table adopts (2014A&A...562L...3G), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2014A%26A...562L...3G/abstract).
